roadmap.title: Quick custom-ruler unlocks
roadmap.description: Single actions, schemes, decisions or traits that a custom or early ruler can finish within minutes.

roadmap.title: Character, court and dynasty milestones
roadmap.description: Raise stats, traits, lifestyle trees, dynasty size and court features over a single lifetime.

roadmap.title: Realm, religion and politics goals
roadmap.description: Hold titles, manage vassals and councils, found orders and faiths, and win wars.

roadmap.title: Scripted-start challenges
roadmap.description: Pick the named historical character and start date, then meet the achievement's special goal.

roadmap.title: Long-campaign and world goals
roadmap.description: Form or restore empires, convert regions, reach hegemony and play to the end of the era.

achievements.description: Marry another character
achievements.summary: Marry another character.

steps.text: Play as any unmarried character.
Marry a character. Someone is always willing.

achievements.description: Complete an entire Lifestyle (all three trees)
achievements.summary: Unlock every perk in all three trees of a Lifestyle.

guide.context: Lifestyle traits alone do not count. The perks must be unlocked in the tree.

steps.text: In 1066, swap England's king for a custom ruler aged 75 of Coptic faith and Syriac culture, with the Mastermind Philosopher education and the Genius and Strong traits. This gives 56 experience per month.
Take the Medicine focus and spend all perks on the health and opinion perks first. Aim to unlock every tree of the Lifestyle.
If the Duke of Normandy attacks you, give in right away.
The last 7 perks arrive in 10 to 11 years.

achievements.displayName: A Legacy to Last the Ages
achievements.description: Complete an entire Dynasty Legacy
achievements.summary: Complete every level of one Dynasty Legacy track.

steps.text: Begin The Carolingians scenario, choosing Charles the Bald of West Francia.
Spend Renown on the Dynasty Legacy levels of one track until the whole track is complete.

achievements.description: Create a Cadet Branch of your Dynasty
achievements.summary: Take the Create Cadet Branch decision to found a Cadet Branch of your Dynasty.

steps.text: Begin the Iberia in Pieces scenario, playing King Antso IV of Navarra.
Take the Create Cadet Branch decision.

achievements.description: Have the maximum amount of dread
achievements.summary: Reach 100 Dread.

steps.text: Make a custom ruler who is Arbitrary, Sadistic and Wrathful.
Pick the Intimidation lifestyle focus.

achievements.description: Suffer from a Mental Break
achievements.summary: Suffer a Mental Break by reaching stress level 1.

steps.text: Reset your lifestyle perks. The achievement unlocks at once.

achievements.description: Use the Claim Throne scheme successfully
achievements.summary: Use the Claim Throne scheme successfully to gain a Pressed Claim on a title.

steps.text: Swap any ducal vassal for a custom ruler carrying the traits Golden Sovereign, Impatient and Schemer. Put the remaining points into Stewardship.
Select the Domain lifestyle focus and spend your free perk on Meritocracy.
Aim a Claim Throne scheme at your liege.

achievements.description: Have ten living children
achievements.summary: Have ten living children.

guide.context: Characters made in the Ruler Designer may not be able to get this achievement.

steps.text: Make a married ruler who already has 9 children and the traits Lustful, Fecund and Seducer.
Run a Seduce scheme on the wife to get a tenth child.
A rite that allows concubines or polygamy makes this very easy.

achievements.description: As Álmos Árpád, form Hungary and convert to Christianity
achievements.summary: As Álmos Árpád, form the Kingdom of Hungary and convert to Christianity.

steps.text: Start as Álmos Árpád.
Go to war through the Migrate to Pannonia casus belli; two strong armies then appear in your capital.
Win the war with the Automate Armies function.
Form the Kingdom of Hungary.
Convert to Christianity.

achievements.description: Starting as Duke Nuño of Portucale in 1066, form Portugal
achievements.summary: Starting as Duke Nuno Mendez of Portucale in 1066, form the Kingdom of Portugal.

guide.context: With Fate of Iberia active, founding Portugal does not require independence while the Struggle is in its Opportunity Phase, which is where the game begins.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Duke Nuno Mendez of Portucale.
Check whether he starts with the Meritocracy perk. If so, use the Claim Throne scheme from the start.
Defeat the Muslim neighbours you need to beat to form Portugal.

Option: on day 1 ally with France and declare an independence war against your liege. Then let France help in the two consecutive wars needed to take the south. Divorcing Nuno's first wife can help you win a useful alliance. Allying with William the Conqueror also works, but his special troops are busy in England for a while.

achievements.description: Have one hundred living dynasty members
achievements.summary: Have 100 living Dynasty members.

steps.text: Start in 1178 as the Rurikids. You have the 100 members at once.

achievements.displayName: A Name Known Throughout the World
achievements.description: Have your dynasty reach the highest possible Level of Splendor
achievements.summary: Have your Dynasty reach the Legendary level of Splendor.

steps.text: Start in 867 as a landed member of the Yamato dynasty; the dynasty begins at the Fabled level of Splendor.
Keep raising your dynasty's Splendor until it reaches the Legendary level.

achievements.description: Play until 1453
achievements.summary: Keep playing until the game date reaches December 1452.

steps.text: Without By God Alone, start in 1178 as Japan. The Fujiwara dynasty has over 400 members, so a game over is very unlikely.
With By God Alone installed, play someone with Ecclesiastical government. You cannot get a game over.
Keep playing until the date passes 1452.12.1.

achievements.description: Reach the highest possible Stress level
achievements.summary: Reach the highest Stress level, level 3.

steps.text: Choose the scenario Wrath of the Northmen and play Bjorn Ironside of Uppland, who begins Honest.
Start 10 Murder Schemes to reach the highest Stress level at once.

achievements.description: Starting as an Iberian Christian, convert all of Iberia to Christianity
achievements.summary: Starting as an Iberian Christian, completely control Iberia and make all its counties Christian.

guide.context: With Fate of Iberia on, hold the Iberian Struggle at its Opportunity phase for as long as you can. You can also start as a Mozarab ruler. That puts you in the Struggle automatically, so you can use its Casus Belli.

steps.text: In 867, swap the Umayyad Sultan for a custom ruler of Andalusian culture, Apostolic faith and the learning education. Choose traits that offset the Opinion loss. Gregarious works with all Muslims. Just and Temperate are virtues to Muslims.
Surrender in the starting wars.
Focus on the Theologian lifestyle tree. Conquer the independent counties before Asturias does.
Next claim the three island counties lying east, followed by Navarra and last Asturias.
Convert every county in Iberia to Christianity.

achievements.description: As a Hindu ruler, hold all seven Hindu Holy Sites at the same time
achievements.summary: As a Hindu ruler, own or be liege of the owner of all seven Hindu holy site counties at the same time.

guide.context: Site holders can follow another religion. Owning the counties, or being liege of whoever does, is enough.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Maharaja Bhoja of Pratihara (Khosala). He already controls every Smartism holy site except one.
Convert to Smartism or Shaktism.
Get a casus belli on the Duke ruler who holds the missing site and take it.

achievements.description: As a French Catholic, hold the Kingdom of Thessalonika without being vassalised to Byzantium
achievements.summary: Be a French Catholic who fully controls the Kingdom of Thessalonika while neither holding nor serving the Byzantine Empire or the Roman Empire.

guide.context: You need all of the kingdom's counties, not the Kingdom of Thessalonika title itself. Another route: play Haesteinn and use the Bellem Justum perk to conquer an easy duchy such as Brittany or Cornwall and form its title. Then do a pilgrimage for prestige and piety, and use the Invade Kingdom Casus Belli on the Byzantines. Train Bondi to counter their Kataphraktoi.

steps.text: Start in 1066 and replace the Byzantine emperor with a custom ruler of French culture and Catholic faith. Choose traits that offset the Opinion penalty.
Take enough land from Hungary and the Pechenegs to be able to form the Empire of Carpathia.
Destroy the Byzantine Empire title.
Make sure you hold every county of the Kingdom of Thessalonika.

achievements.description: Reach the highest possible Prestige Level
achievements.summary: Reach the highest Level of Fame, Exalted Among Men.

steps.text: Begin The Great Adventurers scenario playing Jarl Hæsteinn of Montaigu, who starts at the Illustrious level of Fame.
Win battles and create titles to earn Fame quickly. Winning a Great Holy War adds a huge Prestige reward.

achievements.description: Reach the highest possible Piety Level
achievements.summary: Reach the highest Piety level, Religious Icon.

steps.text: In 867, swap the Abbasid Caliph for a custom ruler of Mashriqi culture and Islamic faith. Give him the traits Just, Generous and Temperate.
Use the Caliphate's gold to make Hajj pilgrimages as often as you can. Pick the options that increase piety rewards each time.
Choose the Theology lifestyle focus and take perks that improve piety at every chance.

achievements.description: Have a child with the Inbred trait
achievements.summary: Get a child who carries the Inbred trait.

guide.context: Characters made in the Ruler Designer may not be able to get this achievement.

steps.text: Pick the scenario called Iberia in Pieces and play King Alfonso VI of Leon.
His lover at the start is his own full sister, Infanta Urraca Fernandez of Leon. Keep having children with her until one is born Inbred.

achievements.description: Found a Holy Order
achievements.summary: Take the Found Holy Order decision.

steps.text: Open the scenario titled The Carolingians and take King Louis II of Italy, who begins nearest to the requirements.
Take the Found Holy Order decision.

achievements.description: Have strong hooks on three direct vassals
achievements.summary: Hold Strong Hooks over three of your direct vassals.

guide.context: Another route is to use the predominant Homosexuality game rule with a ruler under a rite that criminalizes it, such as Bjorn Ironside in 867. After a few years vassals will begin criminal love affairs for you to uncover. The Truth is Relative perk also lets your spymaster fabricate Strong Hooks through the Find Secrets task, mostly on courtiers whom you can then give land.

steps.text: Start in 867 as any Igbo culture Chief.
Conquer until you are a High Chief (Ajapado). Raid with the capture intent to take prisoners.
Use the Igbo Recognition of Talent tradition. Negotiate the release of prisoners by recruiting them, which gives each new courtier a Strong Hook.
Give each of three such courtiers a Chiefdom in your duchy so they become direct vassals.

achievements.description: Know ten secrets simultaneously
achievements.summary: Know ten Secrets at the same time.

steps.text: Seduce characters one after another, since each seduction reveals a Secret.
Keep going until you know ten Secrets at the same time.

achievements.description: Have your Dynasty rule ten independent realms of at least Kingdom tier simultaneously
achievements.summary: Get your Dynasty ruling ten independent realms, each Kingdom tier or higher, simultaneously.

steps.text: In 867, swap the khagan of Kirghiz for a custom ruler who has useful traits and 9 sons. Your start already covers the full de jure land of 3 kingdoms, plus half of 2 others.
Create the kingdoms you already hold and conquer more.
Hand them to your sons and release all of them into independence at once. The Kirghiz Khanate has no de jure land, so you can grant any kingdom independence.

achievements.description: Restore the Roman Empire
achievements.summary: Restore the Roman Empire.

steps.text: Start in 867 as the Byzantine Empire. Or begin as Bulgaria, swear fealty to the Byzantines, and then take over from their emperor.
Hold the Byzantine Empire, the Holy Roman Empire, or the Empire of Italia. Italia comes from the Unify Italy decision.
Take the decision to restore the Roman Empire.
Conquer a lot of land. Focus on military traits and buildings.

achievements.description: Starting as an Irish ruler, hold the Kingdom of Ireland
achievements.summary: Beginning as an Irish ruler, come to hold the Kingdom of Ireland.

steps.text: Select the scenario Rags to Riches and take Petty King Murchad of Munster.
Fabricate claims and conquer the independent counties, which most of Ireland is made of.

Alternatively, start with the August perks of the Diplomacy lifestyle. Their +20 vassalization acceptance lets you get single-county rulers to accept vassalization, from the south to the north, without a war.
Use their feudal taxes to afford a second duchy, then create the Kingdom of Ireland.

achievements.description: Starting as a Count, lead your line to rule an Empire
achievements.summary: Begin the game as a Count and have your line end up with an Empire-tier title.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Ayaz Alp Arslanoglu of West-Tokharestan, heir of Seljuk.
Let the emperor die naturally, or kill him, and you inherit the empire.

achievements.description: Starting as Matilda di Canossa in 1066, rule Italy, have 50 Dynasty members, and found a Holy Order
achievements.summary: Beginning as Matilda di Canossa in 1066, get your Dynasty to hold the Kingdom of Italy, reach 50 living Dynasty members, and take the Found Holy Order decision.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Matilda di Canossa.
Fabricate claims and take every independent county in Italy. Restart the game when your Realm Priest has poor Learning.
In the meantime, obtain a claim to the Duchy of Lombardy. Befriend the Pope (Family Hierarch perks) or fabricate a Hook on him (Schemer perks).
Form the Kingdom of Italy with your land.
Give land to all your sons and to your matrilineal sons-in-law to raise the number of Dynasty members. Rulers and their spouses get a fertility bonus.
Reach 50 living Dynasty members, then take the Found Holy Order decision.

achievements.description: Starting as an Iberian Muslim, control Iberia and take the Avenge the Battle of Tours decision
achievements.summary: Begin as an Iberian Muslim, hold the whole of Iberia, then take the decision called Avenge the Battle of Tours.

steps.text: In 867, swap out the Umayyad Sultan for a custom ruler of Andalusian culture who has the Malinki trait, which fixes his starting Popular Opinion problem.
Surrender in the starting wars.
Conquer the independent counties before Asturias does, then the island counties to the east.
Win back the rebelled duchies.
Once Iberia is fully yours, use the decision named Avenge the Battle of Tours.

achievements.description: Starting as Robert the Fox in 1066, rule Sicily, hold a Greek Kingdom, and convert it to Catholicism
achievements.summary: Beginning as Robert the Fox in 1066, hold the Kingdom of Sicily plus one of the kingdoms of Epirus, Hellas or Thessalonika, and make every original county of that second kingdom Catholic.

guide.context: You do not need to be independent for this. If Roads to Power is not installed, the Byzantines stay Feudal. You can then swear fealty to them, get the Religious Rights feudal contract with a Hook, and conquer and convert as a vassal. Another route: educate your heir as a Greek Orthodox, press his claim on the emperor's throne, and finally switch back to Catholicism along with your vassals, while keeping the Kingdom of Sicily, Naples and Trinacria.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Robert the Fox. Soon after the start, an event gives you a 750-man army in your capital. Raise your Mangonels to the maximum size.
Order your bishop to fabricate a claim to some duchy in Epirus. The Byzantines are weak from the Seljuk invasion and Robert is a strong commander.

Wait for the event where you support a monk's claim to the Byzantine throne, and the Kingdom of Epirus is the payment. Begin the war through that event and win it. It gives 3000 special soldiers and a lot of gold.
Convert every county in Epirus to Catholicism.
Do not start any other war before the events fire.

achievements.description: Starting as any of the Jimena siblings in 1066, become Emperor of Spain
achievements.summary: Beginning as one of the Jimena siblings in 1066, come to hold the Empire of Hispania.

guide.context: You can do this over more than one character's lifetime. With Fate of Iberia on, end the Struggle once possible, but avoid the Status Quo ending since it removes the Hispania title. Create the empire afterwards.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Alfonso, who has high Intrigue. Disable Fate of Iberia if it is installed, so you need not end the Iberian Struggle.
Use murder plots to remove your two brothers within two years and inherit their kingdoms. Agents may take a few months to join.
Enforce your claim to the Kingdom of Navarra.
Pick the decision Unite the Spanish Thrones. It merges Leon, Galicia, Castille and Navarra.
Keep conquering the remaining Iberian peninsula until the Empire of Hispania can be created.

achievements.description: Starting as any child of Ragnarr Lothbrok, conquer all of the British Isles
achievements.summary: Starting as a child of Ragnarr Loðbrók, control the entire Britannia region.

steps.text: Begin the Wrath of the Northmen scenario, playing whichever child of Ragnarr Loðbrók you prefer. Everyone except Earl Alfred of Wessex qualifies; Ivar the Boneless and Halfdan Whiteshirt are the best picks.
Conquer every county in the Britannia region. Holding the empire title itself is optional.

achievements.description: Starting as Count Eudes of Anjou in 867, lead your Dynasty to rule the Kingdom of France
achievements.summary: Playing Count Eudes Capet of Anjou from 867, bring your Dynasty to the Kingdom of France's throne.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Count Eudes Capet of Anjou.
Build up power among your fellow vassals and take the Duchy of Anjou first.
Change your feudal contract. Give your liege high levies and get Protected Title Revocation back. When it is available, offer high taxes for March.
Pick the Meritocracy perk. When you are strong enough to challenge the king, run a Claim Throne scheme for the Kingdom of France.

achievements.description: Starting as William in 1066, win the Invasion, become English, and have only English vassals
achievements.summary: Playing William the Bastard from 1066, win the Norman Invasion, adopt English culture, and keep only English-culture direct vassals under the Kingdom of England.

guide.context: The check covers direct vassals holding a county or duchy within de jure England only.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as William the Bastard and win the Norman Invasion.
Move your Realm Capital to a county that is de jure part of the Kingdom of England. This unlocks the Embrace English Culture decision.
Take the Embrace English Culture decision.
Revoke the duchies of any non-English vassals. If you have an English duke, give him the non-English counts' counties.

achievements.description: Starting as Vratislav Přemyslid in 1066, lead your Dynasty to rule Bohemia and the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.summary: Playing Vratislav Premyslid from 1066, rule the Holy Roman Empire together with the Kingdom of Bohemia.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Vratislav Premyslid.
Wait a few months for enough gold, then create the Duchy of Moravia.
Spend nothing for a few years, then create the Kingdom of Bohemia.
Take the Truth is Relative perk and fabricate a Hook on the Kaiser. Make him vote for you. Between you, you always outvote the other electors.
Then kill the Kaiser and the title is yours.

achievements.description: As Haesteinn of Montaigu in 867, hold any Kingdom tier title
achievements.summary: Playing Haesteinn of Montaigu from 867, come to hold a title of Kingdom tier or above.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Jarl Haesteinn of Montaigu.
Declare war on Cornwall with the Conquer Duchy Casus Belli. Restart if the Cornish get a strong ally.
Move your capital to Cornwall and convert to the local culture.
Recreate the Duchy. Afterwards pick Restore the Kingdom of Cornwall from the decisions.

achievements.description: Starting as Rurik the Troublemaker in 867, lead your dynasty to rule the Empire of Russia
achievements.summary: Beginning as Rurik the Troublemaker in 867, bring your Dynasty to the Empire of Russia.

guide.context: To get more time, you can start several murder plots to stress-suicide Rurik. You then control his sole heir, a 17-year-old who is also a martial-tree character. His stats are weaker, yet succession trouble is far away, giving you ample time to form Russia.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Rurik the Troublemaker and create the Kingdom of Novgorod right away.
Adopt the local culture and religion, like the Varangians did.
Offer vassalage to neighbours whose land is de jure under you. Some gifts may be needed.
Spend your single-per-lifetime Subjugation Casus Belli on Minsk, then keep using Conquer Duchy.
Form the Empire of Russia.

achievements.description: Have a strong hook on your Head of Faith
achievements.summary: Have a Strong Hook on the Head of your Faith.

steps.text: Make a Catholic custom ruler who has Intrigue education, and pick the Truth is Relative perk.
Start working on a fabricated Hook against the Pope.
Hold the scheme back instead of finishing it until a Strong Hook is offered, then accept it.

achievements.description: Have three or more virtuous traits
achievements.summary: Have three or more virtuous traits at the same time.

guide.context: Characters made in the Ruler Designer may not be able to get this achievement.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Bayajidda of Kano, who has two virtues.
Use the decision Seek Aid of the Spirits. If lucky, you become Possessed. If not, reset and retry.

Otherwise look for a Turumism character who starts with two virtuous personality traits out of three. Restart if there are none. This is a little easier in 1066. On this route, finish a hunt to gain the Hunter trait.

achievements.displayName: The Things Love Does for Us
achievements.description: Have a lover save you from a murder attempt
achievements.summary: Be rescued by your lover during a murder attempt on you.

guide.context: Another route: play Jarl Haesteinn, Count of Montaigu, from 867. Become your wife's soulmate, dismiss your spymaster, and wait for Charles the Bald of France, the best-connected rival, to attempt the murder.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Count Otger of Spreewald. A rival of his has high Intrigue, and his wife is his soulmate.
Wait for the rival to attempt to murder you. Restart until your soulmate saves you.
The Mortal Adoration perk improves the odds.
Do not give your lover any titles. That blocks the save.

achievements.description: Use a hook to modify a feudal contract
achievements.summary: Change a Feudal Contract by using a hook.

steps.text: Choose King Harold of England in the scenario called The Fate of England.
Use your Strong Hook on the vassal to change their Feudal Contract.

achievements.description: Defeat a faction in a war
achievements.summary: Defeat a faction in a war; a Peasant Rabble revolt does not count.

steps.text: Start in 867 as the Umayyad.
Surrender in the starting wars so your realm is on the brink of civil war.
Win the civil war against the faction. This can be hard in that state.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade a duchy capital building anywhere in your personal domain
achievements.summary: Finish every upgrade of a duchy building located in your own personal Domain.

steps.text: Create a faith with a rite that has the Megalithic Constructions tenet.
Build the Great Megalith in your Domain. It has no upgrades, so it counts as fully upgraded as soon as it is built.

achievements.description: Create a Faith
achievements.summary: Create a new Faith.

steps.text: Create a Catholic ruler who is at least 27 years old and has a theology education trait.
Take the Prophet lifestyle perk with the starting lifestyle points.
Create your Faith.

achievements.displayName: The Things We Do for Love
achievements.description: Murder your lover's spouse
achievements.summary: Murder your lover's spouse.

steps.text: Take the scenario Iberia in Pieces, playing King Alfonso VI of Leon, whose lover is there from the start.
Marry your lover to someone with low Intrigue.
Launch a Murder scheme targeting her husband.

achievements.description: Inherit a title from someone you murdered
achievements.summary: Inherit a title from a character you murdered while you were their heir.

steps.text: Pick the 867 start and play Ibrahim ibn Ahmad, the Duke of Gabes (a prince).
Launch a Murder scheme on your liege, who is your brother; it never fails.
Inherit the title.

achievements.description: Murder your spouse
achievements.summary: Murder your spouse with a Murder scheme.

steps.text: Make a married custom ruler who is Impatient and a Schemer.
Begin a Murder scheme targeting your spouse and see it through.

achievements.description: Take part in a successful Great Holy War, on either side
achievements.summary: Join the winning side of a Great Holy War, as attacker or defender.

steps.text: Start as a Catholic ruler in 1178.
Wait for the Pope to call a Crusade, usually within twenty years, and join it.
Make sure your side wins the Great Holy War.

achievements.description: Go to war with one of your siblings over a Claim
achievements.summary: Declare a war against one of your siblings using the Claim casus belli.

steps.text: Begin The Carolingians scenario with any character you like.
Declare war on one of your siblings, picking the Claim casus belli.

achievements.description: As any one character, successfully seduce ten people
achievements.summary: Successfully seduce ten people with one character.

steps.text: Build a custom ruler aged 40 with an intrigue education and the Diplomat trait.
Spend the free points on as many perks as you can in the Seducer or Seductress path of the Intrigue lifestyle.
Seduce ten characters.

achievements.description: While holding any empire title, be naked
achievements.summary: Be naked while you hold some Empire title.

guide.context: Characters made in the Ruler Designer may not be able to get this achievement.

steps.text: Start in 1066 and swap the King of France for a custom ruler of Papuan or Nakavaram culture. He needs an age of 42 or more, the Fortune Builder education, and four traits: Temperate, Forgiving, Compassionate and Honest.
Put as much as you can into Stewardship, then Diplomacy to handle the cultural acceptance opinion penalty.
Choose the Wealth lifestyle focus and get all the traits of the Avaricious tree. Immediately take the Sell Trivial Titles and Extort Subjects decisions, choosing the highest gold option.
Prior to unpausing, find the spouse with top Stewardship and put them in charge of your domain.
Put Lodging Standards at maximum and every other Court Amenity at minimum.
Bring Konan mab Konan de Rennes to court as a guest. Once he accepts, go to war with the Duchy of Britanny on the strength of his claim. Siege two castles and win one battle.
With 1250 gold, create the Kingdom of Britanny, then the Empire of Francia.

achievements.description: Have only two distinct parents, grandparents, and great grandparents
achievements.summary: Have no more than 12 distinct ancestors among your parents back to your great-great-great-grandparents.

steps.text: Begin in Iceland and turn on the restricted diplomatic range rule, which keeps neighbours away.
In the Ruler Designer, create a ruler with the Messalianism rite and the Pure-blooded trait.
Marry siblings to each other for three generations.
Guard against cuckoldry. A female ruler with the Homosexuality or Asexuality rules set as predominant makes this safer.
@warn{On recent patches this achievement may never unlock. Rolling back to version 1.13.2 through Steam Betas lets it unlock if the requirements are met.}

achievements.description: Starting as a Karling, be the only independent Karling to hold a landed title
achievements.summary: Starting as a Karling, become independent while no other Karling is landed or independent.

steps.text: In 1066, play Count Herbert of Vermandois. He is a French vassal and the sole landed Karling.
Declare an independence war and surrender. You may be banished as an adventurer, which unlocks the achievement at once.
Or build strong alliances, for example with William the Conqueror or Kaiser Heinrich, and keep your allies out of other wars.
Declare the independence war, call in your allies, and enforce demands when they beat your liege.

achievements.description: Increase your Rank
achievements.summary: Gain a title of a higher rank than the title you held before.

steps.text: Choose The Great Adventurers scenario and take Rurik Rurikid of Novgorod.
Create the Kingdom of Novgorod, which you can do from the start.

achievements.description: Have your culture unlock all innovations, excluding regional and culture-specific innovations
achievements.summary: Have your culture unlock every Military and Civic innovation, excluding regional and culture-specific ones.

steps.text: Change the game rule for Divergent and Hybrid Culture Cooldowns to Faster.
Start as Han culture in 1178.
Create hybrid cultures to speed up innovation progress.
Keep researching until every Military and Civic innovation is done. You can skip Regional, Cultural and Silk Road ones.

achievements.description: Starting as Daurama Daura, have your line reform an African faith, and convert all of Africa to it
achievements.summary: As Magajiya Daurama Daura, reform an African pagan faith, then bring each County on the African continent over to it.

guide.context: All of Africa must follow your religion. Counties that stay with the old, unreformed form of your faith still count, so they need not switch to your reformed one.

steps.text: Start as Daurama Daura. Take the Prophet lifestyle perk, which halves the cost of reforming a faith.
When reforming, choose the Fundamentalist doctrine plus the tenets Mendicant Preachers and Sanctioned False Conversions. Warmonger or Reincarnation is a good third tenet.
Pick the Revocable Clergy doctrine so you can appoint a priest with high Learning to speed up manual conversion.
Do not overuse Holy Wars. They lower fervor, and at 40% or less the unreformed version of your faith can break out as a heresy.
Make sure every county holder in your realm in Africa has your faith.
Keep an eye on neighbouring cultures, new hybrids above all, and hybridize with whichever moves you nearer to feudal.
Keep a Dynasty member at the top of the score so succession does not split the realm. Use political schemes for this.

achievements.description: As a Norse-Asatru ruler, have your capital on any island in the Indian Ocean
achievements.summary: Starting and staying a Norse Ásatrúan, make an Indian Ocean island your realm capital.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Master Ubbe (Scourge of the Saxons). Without the Roads to Power DLC, play Jarl Hæsteinn of Montaigu instead.

As Ubbe, travel with your camp to the island of Socotra and collect Provisions on the way. As Hæsteinn, conquer North African, Tulunid and East African counties. Then move your capital to Socotra after taking it with the Varangian Adventure casus belli.

achievements.description: As an Asatru, hold all of the original Thessalonika, and any empire title other than Byzantium
achievements.summary: As a Norse Ásatrúan, fully control the Kingdom of Thessalonika and hold an empire title other than the Byzantine Empire.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Count Hæsteinn of Montaigu. Attack Count Gregorios of Napoli in a conquest war so you come within range of the Byzantine Empire.
Hire one mercenary company for that war and ransom captured couriers for extra money.
Go to war with the Byzantine Empire through the Invade Kingdom casus belli, targeting Thessalonika. Strike when they are already fighting a war or rebels, if you can.
Besiege counties inside and near Thessalonika first, and lure their armies across a strait.
Form another empire, such as Ajuraan with 18 counties, without taking the Byzantine Empire title.

achievements.description: As an unreformed tribal, form the North Sea Empire
achievements.summary: Make sure you are Tribal and your Faith is unreformed, then take the decision Secure the High Kingdom of the North Sea.

guide.context: Stay Tribal and keep your Faith unreformed until the decision is taken.

steps.text: Play a tribal son of Ragnar, for example Ivar the Boneless, Bjorn Ironside or Sigurdr Snake in the Eye. Conquer England, Denmark and Norway.
Use Scandinavian Elective succession to pick a young heir, and take Learning lifestyle perks that raise health.
Keep all three kingdoms for 30 years, all during a single ruler's life.
While you are still Tribal and your Faith is unreformed, take the decision Secure the High Kingdom of the North Sea.

achievements.description: As a North Germanic Asatru, control all islands in the Atlantic and the Mediterranean, whilst keeping your realm size below a certain threshold
achievements.summary: As a Norse Ásatrúan, fully control all islands of the Atlantic and Mediterranean while never exceeding a realm size of 80.

guide.context: Realm size must never exceed 80 provinces.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Jarl Haesteinn, take part of Sardinia, then invade Thessalonika with mercenaries and capture Constantinople to weaken the Byzantines.
Form or usurp a duchy only. Do not form the Kingdom of Thessalonika yet, because holding any kingdom blocks the Mann & the Isles elevation decision.
Conquer weaker islands to raise Haesteinn's fame to Living Legend, then take the Isle of Mann after Ivar the Boneless's troops die.
The decision called Elevate the Kingdom of Mann & the Isles gives you a kingdom title and more troops, so take it.
Take the remaining islands from the Karlings, Wessex, the Arabs and the Byzantines while keeping realm size at or below 80.

achievements.description: As a Norse tribal, control the entirety of Sicily
achievements.summary: Starting as an independent Norse Ásatrúan, own every county of Sicily's kingdom before 1047.

guide.context: The date limit is 1 January 1047.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Jarl Haesteinn. Take Sicily with the Duchy conquest casus belli at a time when the Byzantines are busy fighting a war.
Move your capital to Palermo and conquer small independent counts and dukes.
Take the Byzantine Sicilian land with a Kingdom conquest casus belli, saving it for last, or swear fealty to the Byzantine emperor and get the remaining counties granted.
If you swore fealty, win an independence war before 1047.

achievements.description: Starting and staying as a North Germanic Asatru of any kind, take the Found Witch Coven Decision
achievements.summary: As a Norse Ásatrúan, take the Found Witch Coven decision.

steps.text: Swap the 867 Chief of Gotland for a custom ruler who is Norse by culture and follows Asatru. Make them 34 years old, give them the Diplomat and Witch traits, and make sure they have 6 children.
Launch Convert to Witchcraft schemes against your children, and include the heir among the targets.
After three children are converted, take the Found Witch Coven decision.

achievements.description: As any one dynasty, commission a hundred rune stones
achievements.summary: Have your dynasty raise a hundred runestones.

guide.context: Runestone cost scales with income, with a minimum of 50, so keep income low and avoid unneeded spending.

steps.text: Swap the 1066 Seljuk Emperor for a custom Norse ruler who is 46, unmarried and has one son. Put every point into Stewardship.
Max the Wealth tree, appoint good tax collectors and save around 6000 gold over ten years.
Surrender to the Dissolution Faction when it forms, then give away all titles except one duchy and three or more of its counties, and surrender to the faction again.
As the duke, give the son one county and a random noble another. Lower that noble's opinion of you, fail to imprison him, and then give in to the rebellion so you get deposed.
As the son, raise a runestone. Bring your father to court, give him land, and imprison the vassal. Keep repeating this until you reach 100, and keep spending and income low.

achievements.description: As a Christian North Germanic, participate in the very first crusade from the start
achievements.summary: As a Catholic North Germanic, join the First Crusade as an attacker.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as a North Germanic Catholic ruler.
Wait until about 1100 for the Pope to call the first Crusade and join it as an attacker.

achievements.description: As a North Germanic or Russian Asatruan of any kind, convert to any Islamic faith & convert all of Russia.
achievements.summary: Convert to an Islamic faith as a Norse-heritage Ásatrúan, then turn every county in the Russian Region to an Islamic faith.

steps.text: In the scenario named The Great Adventurers, choose Rurik Rurikid of Novgorod and switch to an Islamic faith.
Consider lowering the Scandinavian Adventurers frequency in game rules while you are weak.
Finish a Holy Legend at Illustrious level or higher to unlock Evangelize to the Realm. Use it to convert every county in the Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia and in the Empire of Russia (de jure).

achievements.description: As a dwarf, win a Varangian Adventurer war anywhere outside of Europe
achievements.summary: Win a Varangian Adventurer war outside Europe while having the Dwarf trait.

steps.text: Swap the 867 Duke of Småland for a Norse custom ruler. Give that ruler the Dwarf trait.
Raid and hunt to gather troops and prestige.
Win the war you start against the duchy of Karayedisan with the Varangian Adventure casus belli.

achievements.description: Fund an Inspired character's Project, and receive the end result
achievements.summary: Pay for an Inspired character's Project and get the finished result.

steps.text: Take the Commission Artifact decision to fund an Inspired character and see the event chain through.

achievements.description: Create a Hybrid Culture
achievements.summary: Create a Hybrid Culture.

steps.text: Begin the Wrath of the Northmen scenario, playing Ivar the Boneless of Isles.
Take the Hybrid Culture decision immediately.

achievements.description: Create a Divergent Culture
achievements.summary: Create a Divergent Culture.

steps.text: Play a Duke who is a vassal of the Byzantine Empire.
Create a Divergent Culture, changing only the ethos. Most of them can do so from the start.

achievements.description: Have an artifact in every slot in the Inventory and Court
achievements.summary: Own an Artifact in every Inventory slot and every Royal Court slot.

steps.text: Commission the crown, weapon, armor and regalia.
Get trinkets from hunts.
Get journals from the Create Travel Itinerary decision (Wandering lifestyle perk) and the Commission Epic decision (Diplomacy lifestyle perk).

Fill the court with 4 pedestal items, 3 large and 3 small wall ornaments, two furniture items, two books and a throne. Commission the wall ornaments, furniture and books directly, and get pedestal items by reforging inventory artifacts.
The throne is hardest. Playing Scotland in 1066 helps, as it starts with one. Otherwise commission furniture through Commission Artifact and hope for a throne.
With no DLC, play China. With Royal Court or Roads to Power, play the Byzantine Empire in 1066 for many starting artifacts.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum amount of Court Grandeur
achievements.summary: Reach Court Grandeur level 10, the maximum.

steps.text: Start as China in any start date. It begins at the maximum Court Grandeur.

achievements.description: Personally know 10 languages
achievements.summary: Personally know 10 languages.

steps.text: Create a 21-year-old custom character, give them the Erudite Oracle trait, and spend what is left on Learning.
Pick a culture that has the Astute Diplomats tradition (Bolghar, Croatian, Öngüd, Volhynian, Nubian, German or Franconian) or Culture Blending (Muroma, Meshchera, Merya, Avar, Kamrupi, Gond or Mon).
Use the free perks to take Pedagogy and Open-Minded.
Pick the Diplomacy lifestyle and its Adaptive Traditions perk, which gives one more scheme slot.
Run Learn Language schemes until you know 10 languages. Converting to, or hybridizing with, a culture with another language also teaches its language at once.

achievements.description: Sponsor 30 successful inspirations in one game
achievements.summary: Sponsor 30 successful Inspirations in a single game.

steps.text: Start as China in 1066, which offers the fastest progression.
Keep sponsoring Inspirations until 30 have succeeded.

achievements.description: Obtain a mythological rarity artifact from an Adventurer Inspiration
achievements.summary: Obtain the artifact produced by an Adventurer's Inspiration at the highest rarity.

steps.text: Start as an Emperor, which gives the best chance of guests with Inspirations and the money to fund them.
Fund Adventurer Inspirations until one produces the top-rarity artifact.

achievements.description: Rule a realm containing at least 10 cultures with 95% or more acceptance of your culture
achievements.summary: Rule a realm with at least 10 cultures that each have 95% or more acceptance of your culture.

steps.text: In 867, start as High Chieftain Radomil of Lusatia. Your own culture does not count towards the 10.
Slavic cultures begin with 50% acceptance of each other. Polabian culture is the best start and lacks the Staunch Traditionalists tradition.
Should you get a Royal Court, set it to the Administrative type.

achievements.description: Be at least 6 levels above your expected Court Grandeur
achievements.summary: Have a Court Grandeur level at least 6 levels above your expected level.

steps.text: Pick the Iberia in Pieces scenario with any king, and do not expand. Their courts expect only level 1.
Display artifacts and improve court amenities to raise your Court Grandeur.

achievements.description: As a member of the Pugyel Dynasty, re-create the Empire of Tibet
achievements.summary: Create the Empire of Tibet while playing a member of the Pugyel Dynasty.

steps.text: In 1066, pick Gugé's ruler Chéchentsa Tsédé. Restart until you get Diplomacy education, then respec perks to take True Ruler. Namdé Ösung of Gugé in 867 also works.
Vassalize nearly everything in the Empire of Tibet by diplomacy. Maryül and Mjinjaa are the two kingdoms that cannot be vassalized this way.
Claim Maryül as Dynasty Head. To vassalize more targets, sway them and create the kingdoms above them.
Favor gold income so titles are created faster. Mjinjaa is not needed, but a high Fame level can subjugate it, so favor prestige and fame if you go for it.
Namdé Ösung's rite has the Dharmic Pacifism tenet, which bars Holy Wars. A new rite with Warmonger allows conquest.

achievements.description: As the Seljuk Count in Samosata, form Rum and create a Hybrid Culture between Oghuz and Greek
achievements.summary: As a member of House Seljuk, form the Kingdom of Rum, and also make a Hybrid Culture from Oghuz and Greek.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as any House Seljuk member except Alp Arslan. Khuzestan is the best start.
Take control of the duchies that are de jure part of Rum, which the Sultanate of Rum decision demands, then form Rum.
Create a Hybrid Culture with Oghuz and Greek as parents.
Alternative: become an adventurer and conquer. This gives an army stronger than the Byzantine Empire and the Conqueror trait.

achievements.description: Starting as the Duke of Ghur in 867 or 1066, conquer the borders of the historical Ghurid Empire
achievements.summary: Play the Duke of Ghur from the 867 or 1066 start and hold every part of the Historical Ghurid Empire region.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Muhammad Abbaszde. Check his traits; if nothing boosts Stewardship and Learning, quit to the main menu and look again.
Swap his liege for a woman who has sinful traits plus traits that hurt fertility, with her skills set as low as possible, then begin. If your education is not Stewardship, repeat.

Reroll your perks and unlock Meritocracy. Then run a Claim Throne scheme on your liege. When the claimant faction forms, peasants side with you and she hands over the throne peacefully. Kill her to inherit her titles, which gives you Ghur and Kabulistan.
Fill building slots with money buildings and build Men-at-Arms, including at least two regiments of mangonels.
Swear fealty to the Seljuk empire, use Claim Throne again, and marry into alliances.
Start a claimant faction or declare war on the emperor, ideally while he is fighting someone else. Besiege counties one by one on the way to his capital, then conquer the rest of the region.

achievements.description: As the Piasts in 867, rule a Feudal Poland and own a Famed+ regalia, crown, weapon, and armor
achievements.summary: Start as the Piasts in 867, rule a Feudal Kingdom of Poland, and own a Famed or Illustrious regalia, crown, weapon and armor.

steps.text: Start in 867 as the Piasts and conquer Polish land until your realm outpowers the ruler of @loc{Great Moravia}.
Move next to Great Moravia and become Catholic, so its ruler will want you as a vassal.
Swear fealty to Great Moravia, then use the decision called Adopt Feudal Ways through Liege.
Win independence or take over Great Moravia from inside, and make sure you hold the Kingdom of Poland.
Collect one Famed or Illustrious item of each kind: regalia, crown, weapon and armor. Sponsor their creation yourself or take them from other rulers.
For more Inspired characters, build up court grandeur, move to a Scholarly court and pick the first Erudition dynasty legacy.
Take Accomplished Forger to buy claims on artifacts you spot in the character finder, then demand them, steal them or fight a war for them.

achievements.description: Have every Royal Court speak your Court Language
achievements.summary: Have every Royal Court in the world use the same Court Language as yours.

guide.context: A ruler made in the Ruler Designer may not be able to earn this. This method may no longer work on the current game version.

steps.text: Roll the game back to version 1.18. This is the only known route and may not work on newer versions.
Play as China.
Keep playing until every Royal Court in the world has adopted Chinese as its Court Language.

achievements.description: Starting and staying as a Jewish ruler in East Africa, rule a Kingdom and diverge your culture
achievements.summary: As a Jewish ruler holding a Kingdom or Empire title with your capital in East Africa, diverge your culture.

guide.context: A ruler made in the Ruler Designer may not be able to earn this.

steps.text: Start as the King of @loc{Abyssinia} (any start date).
Gain Piety and convert to Haymanot.
Keep your realm small, because the divergence cost grows with realm size.
If the realm is big, give titles and vassals to a vassal outside your de jure land and grant them independence.
Create the divergent culture.

achievements.description: Appoint a character with a completed Adventure inspiration as your Antiquarian
achievements.summary: Appoint a character who has completed an Adventure Inspiration as your Antiquarian.

steps.text: Start as an emperor, since guests with inspirations arrive more often and you can pay for them.
Sponsor a guest's Adventure Inspiration until it is completed.
Appoint that character as your Antiquarian.

achievements.description: Loot an artifact you do not have a claim on and pass it down to your heir
achievements.summary: Loot an Artifact you had no Artifact Claim on, then have your heir inherit it.

steps.text: Start as a ruler who already owns an artifact.
Gift the artifact to a weak ruler.
Declare war on that ruler and loot the artifact back, with no claim on it.
Keep it until your heir inherits it.

achievements.description: With the County of Fika as your primary title, diverge your culture and spread it to 30 Counties
achievements.summary: Diverge your culture while the County of Fika is your primary title, then have 30 counties in your realm share it.

guide.context: Fika must be your primary title only at the moment you diverge. Afterward you may change it.

steps.text: In the game rules, switch off AI hybridization and divergence of cultures, so vassals do not split yours.
Conquer the County of @loc{Fika} and set it as your primary title.
Pick fights with weak neighbors and diverge your culture once you can afford the prestige cost.
Form a duchy and expand, converting counties until 30 in your realm share the new culture.
Converting to the Coptic faith, or reforming your faith to have the Communal Identity tenet, makes culture promotion 50% faster in converted counties.

achievements.description: As a vassal king to an emperor, have a higher court grandeur than they do
achievements.summary: As a vassal Kingdom ruler under an Emperor, have higher Court Grandeur than your liege.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Qocho.
Swear fealty to the Kirghiz Khanate.
Wait until your court grandeur passes your liege's as theirs falls.

achievements.description: Sleep with your best friend while having the "Ritualized Friendship" cultural tradition
achievements.summary: Sleep with your Best Friend while your culture has the Ritualized Friendship tradition.

steps.text: In the game rules, change Sexuality Distribution to Homosexuality.
Pick Ibn-Marwan of Badajoz in the scenario called The Struggle for Iberia.
Swear an Oath of True Friendship, and make the other party Emir Sa'dun ibn Fath of Burtughal.
Use the Seduce scheme on him.

achievements.description: Embrace the Basque paganism faith during the Iberian struggle
achievements.summary: During the Iberian Struggle, adopt Euskal Erlijioa through the decision Champion the Faith of the Country Basques, which is available from 1200 onward.

steps.text: Swap the 867 King of France for a custom character of Basque culture. Give them the Cynical trait plus traits that boost Prestige and Piety.
Raise both Prestige and Piety to 1000, and play to 1200 or later.
Choose the decision Champion the Faith of the Country Basques.

achievements.description: Use a friendship hook on a different-faith ruler involved in the Iberian struggle
achievements.summary: While involved in the Iberian Struggle, use a Best Friend hook on an involved ruler of another Faith.

steps.text: Start in 867 as King Alfonsu III of Asturias.
Offer an Oath of True Friendship to Sheikh Lubb Muzez of Najera.
Use the Best Friend hook on him.

achievements.description: Bet a title on a strategy game match against another ruler
achievements.summary: Bet a title on a board game against another ruler and finish the match.

steps.text: In the Iberia in Pieces scenario, take King Sancho II of Castille or King Alfonso VI of León.
Challenge the other king to a board game with land as the stake and play it to the end.

achievements.description: As an Iberian culture character, control all of the Caucasian Iberia region
achievements.summary: Own every county of Caucasian Iberia while having Iberian heritage.

steps.text: In 867 play the Abbasid and conquer the Caucasian counties you do not hold: the duchy of Georgia, Tao-Klarjeti except Acampse, Hayk and Vanand.
Take Mediterranean islands toward the county of Mayurqa.
Move your realm capital to Mayurqa and convert to the local culture.

achievements.description: Convert all of Iberia to the Mozarabic faith
achievements.summary: Make every county in Iberia follow Mozarabism.

steps.text: Swap the 867 Umayyad Sultan for a custom ruler of Andalusian culture and Mozarabism faith. Give them Learning education and traits that offset opinion loss.
Surrender in the starting wars.
Convert your counties with the Theologian lifestyle tree. Hold the Iberian Struggle in its Opportunity phase for as long as you can.

achievements.description: End the Iberian struggle through means of force
achievements.summary: End the Iberian Struggle with the Dominance ending.

steps.text: Swap the 867 Umayyad Sultan for a custom ruler of Andalusian culture and Malinki faith. Surrender in the wars you start with.
Create a second kingdom title before any vassal manages to, and convert the counties in the kingdom that holds your capital.
Put tax buildings in your castle holdings to push the struggle toward Hostility. Then pick the Dominance ending.

achievements.description: End the Iberian struggle by setting your differences aside
achievements.summary: End the Iberian Struggle with the Détente ending.

steps.text: Swap the 867 Umayyad Sultan for a custom ruler of Andalusian culture and Malinki faith. Give them Prestige traits and several daughters.
Push the struggle toward Conciliation by putting tax buildings in your city holdings.
Release vassals until you control under 50% of Iberia. Do not give up any holding inside your primary kingdom title.
Ally with every independent involved ruler, then choose the Détente ending.

achievements.description: End the Iberian struggle through compromise
achievements.summary: End the Iberian Struggle with the Status Quo ending.

steps.text: Take part in the Iberian Struggle. To reach the Compromise phase, build tax buildings first in city holdings and next in castle holdings.
Release vassals until you hold under 50% of Iberia. Every holding inside your primary kingdom title must stay with you.
Have 60 opinion or a strong hook on every independent involved ruler, then choose the Status Quo ending.

achievements.description: Start as an uninvolved character, become involved and end the Iberian struggle
achievements.summary: Start uninvolved in the Iberian Struggle, become involved, and end it.

steps.text: Start in 1178 as Mu'minid and declare an invasion war on Castille, choosing the Kingdom of Castille.
Once you win, hand your starting domain to another character and relocate your capital into the domain you conquered.
Give away the head of faith title, convert to Malinki, and when the struggle reaches Compromise choose the Status Quo ending.

achievements.description: Create and rule the kingdom of Valencia as an heir to El Cid
achievements.summary: As an heir of El Cid, create and rule the Kingdom of Valencia.

steps.text: Play El Cid in The Wandering Exiles scenario and finish his story as a vassal of Castille.
Grow strong, then seize the throne from your liege.
Claim a county in Valencia, preferably in a duchy mostly held by one state, then take the whole duchy using the claim your priest offers.
Reach 6 counties by fighting with the Struggle Clash casus belli, then form the Kingdom of Valencia.

achievements.description: Visit ten Kingdom Tier Vassals on a Grand Tour
achievements.summary: Visit ten Kingdom-tier vassals on one Grand Tour.

steps.text: Create an empire title and vassalize as much of India as you can, until you have ten Kingdom-tier vassals.
Plan a Grand Tour that visits ten of them.

achievements.description: As a Regent, sucessfully coup your liege to take their Realm without War or Schemes
achievements.summary: While Regent, pull off a successful Coup against your liege to take their realm, using no war and no Schemes.

guide.context: The scales decay every year and your liege can swing them too, so holding level 6 is hard.

steps.text: Start in 1066 in the Fatimid Sultanate, which begins with a regency. Play a strong vassal such as the Emir of Alexandria. Or make a genius ruler with high stats in the Ruler Designer and give them a spouse with 20+ in the needed skill.
Run the Overthrow Regent scheme against the Fatimid regent to take their post.
Create or join the dissolution faction so the Sultanate cannot dissolve on its own.
Marry a spouse with 20+ in the skill matching the regency mandate: Stewardship for Fill Coffers, Martial for Swell Armies, Diplomacy for Promote Authority.
Succeed at the mandate events and use the Swing the Scales decision to hold Scales of Power level 6.
Kidnap your liege so they cannot swing the scales from jail, then release them and Coup once the other conditions are met.

achievements.description: As an Emperor, go on an Intimidation Tour visiting all of your Powerful Vassals
achievements.summary: While an Emperor, finish an Intimidation Tour that stops at every Powerful Vassal you have.

steps.text: Pick Kaiser Heinrich IV, ruler of the Holy Roman Empire.
Start an Intimidation Tour and visit every Powerful Vassal.

achievements.description: Successfully host a Murder Feast or Bloody Wedding
achievements.summary: Host a successful Bloody Wedding or Murder Feast.

steps.text: Create an Intrigue ruler in @loc{Göttingen} with the Elusive Shadow education, aged 37 or older.
Take the Forever Infamous perk, which unlocks the feast.
Start a Murder Feast and see it through.

achievements.description: Finish both tracks of the Traveler Trait
achievements.summary: Finish both tracks of the Traveler trait.

steps.text: Travel until you gain the Traveler trait.
Travel often to fill the Wanderer track.
For the Seasoned track, keep travel Safety low: avoid a safe Caravan Master and safe travel options.
Plan trips that detour through provinces with high Danger, and change the route mid-trip to pass battles and sieges.
In Danger events avoid the safest options, which can give little or no Seasoned experience.

achievements.description: Finish any track in the Hastiluder Trait
achievements.summary: Finish any track of the Hastiluder trait.

steps.text: Take perks from the Strategist and Gallant trees, which speed up Hastiluder experience.
Take the fifth Activities dynasty legacy for more experience.
Take part in tournaments until one track is full.

achievements.description: Finish all tracks in the Hastiluder Trait
achievements.summary: Finish all tracks of the Hastiluder trait.

steps.text: Take the fifth Activities dynasty legacy for a bonus to Hastiluder experience.
Level the left Strategy lifestyle branch and the right Chivalry branch.
Keep taking part in tournaments until every Hastiluder track is full.

achievements.description: Orchestrate a Grand Wedding where the Spouses become Soulmates
achievements.summary: Run a Grand Wedding that ends with the couple becoming Soulmates.

steps.text: Be one of the two spouses.
Plan the Grand Wedding and choose Seduce as your intent toward your betrothed.

achievements.description: Have one of your Lowborn Knights win a Grand Tournament Joust, then land them
achievements.summary: Land a Lowborn Knight of yours after they win a Joust at a Grand Tournament.

steps.text: Host a Grand Tournament that has a Joust.
In the downtime before the Joust, open Your Knights at the bottom right.
Allow only your Lowborn Knights to enter and block everyone else.
After a Lowborn Knight wins, land them.

achievements.description: Succeed with the Murder Intent while on a Hunt
achievements.summary: Kill someone successfully through the Murder intent during a Hunt.

steps.text: Start a Hunt.
Once you arrive, change your intent to Murder.
Pick a participant with low Intrigue as the target.

achievements.displayName: Lions and Tigers and Bears, Oh My!
achievements.description: Capture a large wild animal while on a Hunt
achievements.summary: During a Hunt, take a large wild animal alive.

guide.context: Wolves and hyenas cannot be captured when you target them on purpose.

steps.text: Start a normal Hunt, not a legendary one.
Target a lynx, bear, leopard, lion or tiger. Big cats are common in African deserts and Indian jungle, while lynxes and bears live in Europe, Tibet and on the steppe.
Choose to corner the animal, not ambush it, then choose to capture it.
A random wolf or hyena encounter also counts if you have very high Diplomacy and choose to befriend it.

achievements.description: Finish the Falconer track in the Hunter Trait
achievements.summary: Finish the Falconer track of the Hunter trait.

steps.text: Create or play a character of Bedouin culture.
Take the fourth Activities dynasty legacy for faster experience.
Hold many Hunts. Do not invite faraway guests, since that slows the Hunt start.

achievements.description: With one Character, go on Pilgrimages to all of your Holy Sites
achievements.summary: With one character, go on a pilgrimage to every holy site of your faith.

steps.text: Create a character in central Africa who follows a local pagan faith, so all holy sites are close.
Choose Martial education, Hausa culture and the Forder, Pilgrim and Hajji traits, make them at least 21, and spend all spare points on Stewardship.
Take the Organized March lifestyle perk for travel speed.
Make a separate pilgrimage to each holy site. One trip passing several does not count.

achievements.description: Participate in a Joust with a maxed out Horse track for the Hastiluder Trait
achievements.summary: Enter a Joust once the Horse track of your Hastiluder trait is full.

steps.text: Fill the Horse track yourself. A champion does not count.
Take perks from the Strategist and Gallant trees and the fifth Activities legacy for faster experience. Traveling also gives a little Horse experience.
Jousts need the Horseshoes and Arched Saddle innovations, plus one of: a capital in Europe, the Chanson de Geste tradition, or the Chivalry tradition.
Take part in a Joust, which cannot be held in mountains or wetlands.

achievements.description: Pass through every Terrain, including naval, whilst on the same Travel
achievements.summary: Pass through every Terrain, including naval, on the same Travel.

steps.text: Make a custom character and give them the Pilgrim trait.
Plan a long trip and add detours through each terrain type by hand.
Detours can only add a little travel time, so begin in northern taiga or southern jungle and finish at the far end of the map.
Pass through Egypt for floodplains and oasis.
Include both naval terrains: Sea and Coastal Sea.

achievements.description: Succeed at a Legendary Hunt
achievements.summary: Succeed at a Legendary Hunt.

steps.text: Employ a Master of the Hunt who has the Hunter trait and high Prowess.
Keep assigning the Track Legendary Game task until a legendary beast is sighted.
Start the Legendary Hunt and win it.

achievements.description: Win every Contest at a Grand Tournament with at least three Contests
achievements.summary: Take first place in all Contests of a Grand Tournament that has three or more.

steps.text: Gather very strong knights and vassals so most rivals fail to qualify.
Choose Contests with one-against-one rounds: board game, duel, wrestling or joust.
Let your subjects give up to you in each round.

achievements.description: Have a max rank Acclaimed Knight with the Warrior of the Faith Trait
achievements.summary: Own an Acclaimed Knight in the top Accolade rank who carries the Warrior of the Faith, Crusader or Mujahid trait.

guide.context: You do not have to win the war, but the knight must fight in the target kingdom, in a siege or battle.

steps.text: Start as a Norse ruler of any kind in 867. Norse cultures earn +20% glory from cultural traditions and rite tenets.
Raid across the sea using the Adventure raid intent, to get many battles.
Create the accolade once you are a King. Acclaimed knights earn glory per won battle they join, and rank 6 is the max.
Keep the accolade supplied with a successor, or it loses rank.
Option 1: conquer Rome from the pope, convert to Christianity to unlock Crusades, join the early Jerusalem Crusade and send armies to the war goal so your knight gains the trait.

Option 2: use pilgrimage Piety to found a new religion with the Theocratic Clerical Tradition, Temporal Head of Faith and Armed Pilgrimages tenet, then call your own Great Holy War. Your knight must fight in the target kingdom.

achievements.description: Starting as the Habsburgs, rule the Archduchy of Austria, plan 5+ Grand Weddings and don't wage War
achievements.summary: Begin as the Habsburgs, hold the Archduchy of Austria, arrange at least five Grand Weddings, and never declare a war.

guide.context: Title petitions fail when your liege's crown authority is at its lowest. Wars you did not declare are allowed, such as tyranny wars against you, factions, crusades and ally wars.

steps.text: Start as the Habsburgs. Either use Diplomacy and Piety to get duchy claims from the pope and petition your liege for the titles, or take the Intrigue path as Werner in @loc{Aargau}.

Intrigue path: wed your son into the Austrian ducal family, use Intrigue schemes to murder the two sons who would otherwise inherit, and let your grandchildren inherit. Have your bishop produce claims on the Steyermark duchy, then petition for it.
Arrange five Grand Weddings. Grand Weddings may give you a strong hook over your liege, which the Archduchy of Austria decision requires. The first Activities dynasty legacy raises the chance.
Make sure the emperor is free and will attend each wedding.
Take the Archduchy of Austria decision.
Never declare any war yourself.

achievements.description: Have a capital Barony with 60+ income, a stationed 500+ Heavy Cavalry Regiment and a mine
achievements.summary: Own a capital Barony earning 60 or more income, a mine, and a stationed Heavy Cavalry regiment of 500 or more.

guide.context: Only the Tax shown in the Holding view counts. Monthly Income modifiers such as Greedy or Wealth Focus do not.

steps.text: Pick a county with one of the 27 special mine slots and build the mine. Good choices: Bambuk, Göttingen, Mudigonda, Malaya and Bure. Avoid desert or dry terrain.
Make that holding the county capital and your capital.
Raise its Tax with buildings, Development, Tax Offices in the duchy slot, high Stewardship and Collect Taxes with a skilled steward.
Add extra Tax: the Avaricious trait (+15%), the Absolute Control perk (+10%), serving as your liege's steward (+10% when they are an emperor), and Improved Pastures events (+20%).
Keep a stationed Heavy Cavalry regiment of 500 or more.

achievements.description: As a character of a faith with the Fadaeyeen Doctrine, dispose of a Lowborn, a King and an Emperor
achievements.summary: Using a Faith with the Fedayeen tenet, successfully murder a lowborn character, a king and an emperor.

steps.text: Start as Vali of Bam and appoint a Master Assassin.
Choose the Intrigue focus and swear fealty to the Saffarids for longer diplomatic range.
Succeed in Murder schemes against a lowborn character, a nearby king with low Intrigue, and the Byzantine emperor.

achievements.description: Fill Five Tax Collector slots with excellent Aptitude characters
achievements.summary: Fill five Tax Collector slots with characters of excellent aptitude.

steps.text: Start as Ghaznavid in 1066 and appoint a vizier to unlock five Tax Collector slots.
Fill the slots with high-Learning characters, using the search for tax collectors decision and children sent to university.
Let the vizier push the balance of power high to raise their aptitude until all five have excellent aptitude.

achievements.description: Take the Iranian Resurgence ending in the Iranian Intermezzo Struggle
achievements.summary: End the Iranian Intermezzo Struggle with the Iranian Resurgence outcome.

steps.text: Replace the Abbasid Caliph with a Persian-culture custom character with traits that offset opinion loss.
Play through the struggle and take the Iranian Resurgence ending.

achievements.description: Take the Renew Caliphate ending in the Iranian Intermezzo Struggle
achievements.summary: End the Iranian Intermezzo Struggle with the Renew Caliphate outcome.

steps.text: Play as the Abbasid Caliph. Beat the rebellion you start with, and after that take over the Arabian peninsula.
Declare war on the Tulunids using your pressed claim.
Conquer eastern rulers who are not Sunni. Rulers who carry the Detractor of the Caliphate trait must either be conquered or turned into supporters by fabricating Weak Hooks on them.
Raise devotion by going on pilgrimages. Once the Stabilization phase arrives, pick the Renew Caliphate ending.

achievements.description: As a character of Iranian Heritage, hold the Empire of Persia, Kingdom of Thessalonika, and Kingdom of Hellas
achievements.summary: With Iranian heritage, own the Empire of Persia, the Kingdom of Thessalonika and the Kingdom of Hellas.

steps.text: Play the Seljuk Emperor from 1066. Win the war already under way, and keep your special troops safe.
Go on pilgrimages to reach the devotion needed for Kingdom-level holy wars.
Murder the Byzantine Emperor by plot so the truce no longer applies. Declare a holy war for Pontus, and then start duchy wars for the targets.
Switch to a culture with Iranian heritage, and keep the Kingdoms of Thessalonika and Hellas titles in your own hands.

achievements.description: Loot four Illustrious-Tier Vizier Extravagance Modifiers from your Vizier
achievements.summary: Loot four Illustrious Vizier Extravagance modifiers from your Vizier.

guide.context: If the vizier dies you must start over, but the stacks stay when you die.

steps.text: At peace, right-click a tax collector to appoint a vizier.
Wait about 16 years while the vizier gains modifiers from Notable up to four Illustrious ones, sending gifts so the vizier always has over 400 gold.
Right-click the vizier and use Mulct Vizier, then Aggressive Auditing, to loot the four Illustrious modifiers.

achievements.description: As a character of a Faith with Jizya or Tax Nonbelievers Doctrines, have ten Vassals of other faiths
achievements.summary: Have ten vassals of other faiths while your Faith uses the Jizya doctrine or the Tax Nonbelievers tenet.

steps.text: Begin the 1066 start as the Seljuk emperor; the condition is met right away.

achievements.description: Starting as a member of the Umayyad Dynasty, hold the Empire of Arabia and the Sunni Caliphate
achievements.summary: Begin as an Umayyad Dynasty member and end up holding both the Sunni Caliphate and the Empire of Arabia.

guide.context: The Caliphate is destroyed if its holder loses all of his land. As an alternative, set the game rule that makes the Abbasids Administrative. Taking their throne then hands you the Caliphate title together with the empire.

steps.text: Start in 867 as al-Andalus, a member of the Umayyad Dynasty.
Seize the weaker duchies along the African coast, then use those to capture Krete. After that you can swear fealty to the Abbasids.
Run a Claim Throne scheme to win the Empire of Arabia from the Abbasids.
Get piety level 3 before you become emperor, or a different character may create the Caliphate title first.
As emperor, let the Caliphate go independent and then use the decision that restores it. No prestige is needed for it, which lets you disregard the truce and keep conquering.

achievements.description: Take the 'Found a New Caliphate' foundation as part of the Abbassid Humiliation ending in the Iranian Intermezzo Struggle
achievements.summary: End the Iranian Intermezzo Struggle with the Abbasid Humiliation outcome by choosing the Found a New Caliphate foundation.

steps.text: Swap the Abbasid Caliph for a custom character who has both the Sayyid and Wise Man traits.
Gain enough Piety to convert to Isma'ilism.
Pass the Sunni Caliphate title on to another character, then choose the decision Announce Opposition to Caliphate.
Convert to Isma'ilism and end the struggle with the Found a New Caliphate foundation.

achievements.displayName: All Your Caliphate Are Belong To Us
achievements.description: Take the 'Dominate the Caliph' foundation as part of the Abbasid Humiliation ending in the Iranian Intermezzo Struggle
achievements.summary: Pick the Dominate the Caliph foundation when the Iranian Intermezzo Struggle ends with Abbasid Humiliation.

guide.context: Whoever holds the Sunni Caliphate, the Caliph, also has to hold the Arabian Empire.

steps.text: Begin as Amiran Ya'qub of Makran, or swap him for a custom ruler.
Win the war you start in, then take over as many independent realms as possible.
Move your House Unity toward Antagonistic. That lets you use the Subjugate Kingdom Casus Belli without limit.
Use that Casus Belli to conquer Mesopotamia and Jazira.
Take as many Levant counties from the Caliph as you can. The Levant has many counties, so out-conquering him there is hard.
Hold the County of Samarra yourself for five years. A vassal holding it does not count.
Once you are bigger than the Empire and the five years are up, take the Dominate the Caliph decision.

achievements.description: Contract, and recover from, the Bubonic Plague
achievements.summary: Contract the Bubonic Plague and recover from it.

steps.text: In the game rules, make Plague Frequency Doomsday and let the Black Death happen whenever.
Create a custom character who is Herculean (or Amazonian), Strong, Temperate and a Conscientious Scribe.
Choose the Medicine focus, and take the Whole of Body perks. Always keep the top Personal Physician you can find.
When Bubonic Plague appears, travel to infected baronies. Raise an army with yourself as general and station it in an infected barony to catch the plague most reliably.
Your Personal Physician's treatment event has to fire in the first year after you catch Bubonic Plague. If it never appears, dismiss and rehire the physician.
When the event comes up, pick the risky treatment. The achievement also unlocks if the bubonic trait simply wears off.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum level of Legitimacy
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum Legitimacy level.

steps.text: Create a 33-year-old custom character who has these traits: Virtuoso Arbitrator, Just, Diplomat and Sayyid.
Pick the Diplomacy Lifestyle, then the Writing History perk.
You start at Legitimacy level 4 with half of level 5 done; keep playing until you reach the top level.

achievements.description: Travel to a safe holding while your Capital is infected by a Epidemic
achievements.summary: Travel to a holding without a plague while your capital barony has a plague.

steps.text: Set Plague Frequency to Doomsday in the game rules.
When a plague reaches your realm, move your capital to it, revoking titles if needed.
Travel to a plague-free barony through an activity. A Pilgrimage works best, as the plague cannot catch up with you.

achievements.description: As a Scottish character, complete a Legend claiming your descent from Ancient Egypt
achievements.summary: As a Scottish character, complete the Sons of Scota Legend claiming descent from Ancient Egypt.

steps.text: Set the Legend Cost game rule to Very Low.
In 1066, swap the King of Scotland for a Scots-culture character with high Diplomacy and a few children.
Let William conquer England first. Ally with him and have him take the de jure land that you still lack.
Create the duchy titles and build prestige up to level 4.
Start the Sons of Scota Legend. You do not need to raise its quality.

achievements.description: Manage to make your Legend Protagonist a Saint
achievements.summary: Make your Legend Protagonist a Saint by giving them the Venerated Ancestor trait.

steps.text: Unlock the third Heroic Bloodline Dynasty Legacy level.
Choose yourself as the Legend Protagonist.
Complete a Holy Legend of Mythical quality to gain the Venerated Ancestor trait.

achievements.description: Successfully claim your Liege's title while having a higher Legitimacy Level than them
achievements.summary: Successfully claim your Liege's title through diplomacy while your Legitimacy Level is higher than theirs.

steps.text: In 867, swap the Duke of the Doolani Amirate, which belongs to the Habbari Sultanate, for a custom character who is Just and Sayyid and uses the Diplomacy focus.
You begin at Legitimacy 4/5 while your liege is at 1/5.
Go on hunts, hold feasts and do other activities that raise Prestige until you reach 1500.
Use the Claim your Liege's title interaction. Winning the war is not required.

achievements.description: Have an infected Barony at the maximum Epidemic Resistance
achievements.summary: Own an infected barony that has 100 Plague Resistance.

steps.text: In 1066, start as Mahasamanta Parakkirama of Pandya, a vassal of Chola.
Construct temple holdings in Madurai, then upgrade every holding.
In your capital duchy, build the Burial Site, plus Hospices and Monasteries in every Madurai barony, and upgrade them.
When a plague appears in your realm, use the Isolate Capital decision.
Employ the strongest Personal Physician available, and use Control Plagues.

achievements.description: Complete a Legend
achievements.summary: Complete a Legend.

steps.text: Set the Legend Cost game rule to Very Low.
Start a Legend and complete it.

achievements.description: Host a Funeral for your Legend Protagonist
achievements.summary: Host a Funeral for a character who is your Legend Protagonist.

steps.text: Make a dead character your Legend Protagonist.
Then host a Funeral for them.

achievements.description: As a Count, complete a Mythical Legend
achievements.summary: Complete a Legend of Mythical quality while holding the Count rank.

steps.text: In the game rules, make Legend Cost Very Low and Legend Spread Chance Very High.
In 867, swap the Chief of Gotland for a custom ruler who has the Holy Monarch trait and high Stewardship. That trait unlocks a legend seed with no fame or piety requirement.
Ask every neighbouring ruler to promote the legend as often as you can, and save gold to petition more rulers. Conquering Baltic coast land opens up more rulers.
Alternative: begin the Legend while a King or Emperor and get it promoted. After your death, pick a new destiny as a Count, claim the Legend from your dead relative, and finish it.

achievements.description: Complete your ancestor's Legend after their death
achievements.summary: Complete a Legend after its owner has died.

steps.text: Start creating a Legend and leave it unfinished until the character dies.
Play as the heir and claim the Legend's ownership before you unpause, so no other relative finishes it.
Complete the Legend.

achievements.displayName: The old man of the mountain
achievements.description: Complete Hassan-i Sabahs unique content by destroying an Empire
achievements.summary: As Hasan Sabbah, complete his unique content by destroying an Empire.

guide.context: The whole story must end within Hasan Sabbah's lifetime.

steps.text: Play Hasan Sabbah and stay in Persia. Build Piety with pilgrimages and the Prolific Pilgrims perk, and build an army.
Do not take the Evangelize the Faith decision yet. Wait to be called to Cairo.
In Cairo keep growing your army until the Egyptian Caliph dies. That death starts a story event that lets you convert to Nizarism.
Always choose story options that advance you down the path.
An event sends you back to Persia. Now Evangelize as much as you can, which grants special soldiers.
Hold off until the Persian Emperor dies, since his successor is weaker. Keep declining enemy of the faith offers until the young emperor is offered.
Found the Assassins, wait for civil wars, then start the revolution and win the final war.

achievements.description: Have every camp followers temperament be positive and have at least 10 camp followers
achievements.summary: Have at least 10 camp followers while your camp temperament is Steadfast.
