steps.text: Start in 1066, swapping King Harold of England for a custom ruler who has 9 children and a spouse, and put every point into Diplomacy.
Surrender to William so you become an Adventurer.
Check that your camp has at least 10 followers and a Steadfast temperament.

achievements.description: Complete El Cid's unique content with the 'An Honorable Man' ending
achievements.summary: Complete El Cid's story with the loyal 'An Honorable Man' ending.

steps.text: Play as Rodrigo Díaz.
Pick the loyal choice every time a story event appears.

achievements.description: As a Legitimist Adventurer, win a claim war for a Kingdom or Empire
achievements.summary: Be a Legitimist Adventurer and win a war fought over a claim to a Kingdom or Empire.

guide.context: The Legitimist Support contract pays out troops and gold only at Exalted Among Men or higher. The contract vanishes if you leave for other work.

steps.text: Start in 1178 as landless Master Todor, who begins with 10k special troops plus lots of gold and prestige.
Purchase a claim from the Patriarch in Byzantium on an Orthodox state title; this makes you Legitimist.
Use his troops and a few bought or requested men-at-arms to win a claim war over a Kingdom or Empire, such as Georgia under Tamar or a weakened Byzantine Empire.
Other starts: accept defeat as King Harold in 1066, or give up your land as Prince Pascueten of Brittany in 867. Hoard gold for mercenaries or use Request Legitimist Support on a neighboring King.

achievements.description: Choose to set out on an Adventure as a spawned Historical Character
achievements.summary: Switch to a Historical Character who has just spawned in your realm, and set out on an Adventure as that character.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Count Werner of Worms, who owns Speyer.
Unpause the game. Regino of Prüm spawns right away.
Choose to play as Regino of Prüm.

achievements.description: Choose a New Destiny 5 times in the same campaign
achievements.summary: Pick the New Destiny option five times within a single campaign.

guide.context: Only Choose a New Destiny at succession counts. Other character switches do not count, but they do not reset your progress either, even if you change dynasty.

steps.text: Play a dynasty with many living members, such as the Rurikids in 1178 with over 100.
At each succession, always pick Choose a New Destiny.
To speed up deaths, start the longest pilgrimage you can, maximize Danger and take the riskiest options. Maxing stress also helps.
Repeat until you have done it 5 times.

achievements.description: As Baudouin of Jerusalem in 1178, defeat Saladin in a war
achievements.summary: Win a war against Saladin while playing Baudouin of Jerusalem from the 1178 start.

steps.text: Set the game rule Conquerors: Frequency to None so Saladin never gets the Conqueror trait.
Start in 1178 as King Baudouin IV of Jerusalem.
Fill your men-at-arms slots to the maximum, mostly crossbowmen.
Marry your sister to a strong ally, such as Hungary or Georgia.
Declare war on a county beside your borders, then let your ally come to help.
Beat Saladin's army with your ally's help.

achievements.displayName: New Management, same as the Old Management
achievements.description: As an Islamic Sultanate of Rum, adopt Administrative Government while owning Constantinople
achievements.summary: As the Islamic Sultanate of Rum, own Constantinople and adopt Administrative Government.

steps.text: Start in 1178 as Salah al-Din, the Sultan of Egypt.
Max out your Mubarizun and Trebuchet regiments, and hire at least three Pikemen regiments and max them out.
Subjugate the Sultanate of Rum, then take its title yourself so you rule as the Sultan of Rum.
Conquer Constantinople and swear fealty to Byzantium.
Take the Adopt Centralized Administration decision.

achievements.displayName: Rags to Riches to Rags to Riches
achievements.description: Starting as a Count, rule an Empire, become an Adventurer, then rule an Empire again
achievements.summary: Become an emperor, then an Adventurer, then an emperor again.

guide.context: You may use one or several characters, but holding other titles in between can stop the achievement. You cannot lose your title while fighting a foreign ruler.

steps.text: In 867 create a Baron who is a vassal of the Khagan of Khazaria, aged 44, with the Conniving Puppetmaster education, Sadistic and Deceitful traits, high Intrigue and one son.
Raise Authority to Limited Tribal Authority. Take the Stewardship lifestyle and all Schemer perks, then wait for a Stewardship perk to pick Meritocracy.
Start Claim Throne and Abduct schemes on the Khagan. Do not finish Abduct before you hold the claim.
Marry your son to a woman aged 46 or older who cannot have children, so there is no other heir.
With the claim ready, finish the Abduct scheme and start a Claimant Faction. Press your claim once the Khagan is imprisoned, and enforce demands to become Khagan.
Surrender to any other wars first. Then revoke a title from a vassal with a 0% chance of success, so they start a war over your Tyranny.
Surrender to your vassals to be deposed and become an Adventurer. Your son becomes Khagan.
Run a Murder scheme on him. When it succeeds you are Khagan again.

achievements.description: As Princess Tamar, rule all of Georgia and fully Conquer Armenia and Daylam
achievements.summary: Playing Princess Tamar, hold all of Georgia and take complete control of Armenia and Daylam.

guide.context: If the Mongol start date is Historical, they arrive fast. You may swear fealty to them and still finish, as long as you fully control all three kingdoms before Tamar dies.

steps.text: Set the Gender Equality game rule to Inverted.
Start in 1178 as Princess Tamar, or as King Giorgi III, who has poor health and passes Georgia to Tamar when he dies.
Give Tamar a duchy early if you are still playing Giorgi, then conquer.
Deal first with the lands that bigger rulers are likely to grab. Armenia is the best first target because the Byzantines, Abbasids or Rum could take it.
Fight in mountains and hills with Pikemen, and bring a full stack of trebuchets for the high-level forts.
Ally with stable neighbors such as Hungary or the Byzantine Empire.
Fully control the Kingdoms of Georgia, Armenia and Daylam before Tamar dies.

achievements.description: Become the Emperor of a newly-formed Latin Empire through a Crusade
achievements.summary: Through a Crusade, end up as emperor of the freshly founded Latin Empire.

guide.context: To qualify for the event, be the most powerful Catholic leading the crusade, or use high Martial to demand the lead.

steps.text: Play a strong Catholic ruler such as England, France, the Holy Roman Empire or Hungary, so you can lead the crusade.
If you are not the strongest Catholic, use very high Martial skill to say you will join the deviated Crusade only if you lead it.
Call or join the Crusade, wait for the deviated Crusade event, and take the lead role in it. The new Latin Empire is then yours and you gain the Despoiler of Byzantium trait.

achievements.description: Become a Dominant Family within Byzantium
achievements.summary: Become a Dominant Family in an Administrative empire.

guide.context: Any Administrative empire counts, not only Byzantium.

steps.text: Set the game rule Extra Administrative Realms - Persia to Administrative.
In the 1178 start, play Jahan Pahlavan Mohammed IV of Azerbaijan.
The achievement unlocks right away.

achievements.description: Adopt the Administrative Government via Decision
achievements.summary: Adopt the Administrative Government by taking the Adopt Centralized Administration decision.

steps.text: Play a king whose land is near the Byzantine Empire.
Swear fealty to Byzantium.
Take the Adopt Centralized Administration decision.

achievements.description: Starting in 1178, Re-Establish the Theodosian Borders
achievements.summary: In a campaign begun in 1178, enact the decision named Re-Establish the Theodosian Borders.

guide.context: The decision needs these duchies: Diyarmudar (in Jazira), Amman and Shammar (in Arabia), Syrte (in Africa), all Byzantine kingdoms apart from Serbia, Croatia, Armenia and Georgia, plus Egypt, Syria and Jerusalem at kingdom level.

steps.text: Start in 1178 as Salah al-Din of the Ayyubids and declare a holy war for Jerusalem right away.
Keep conquering the required land and build up Piety. Leave Rum for later.
Switch to any Christian rite you like, become a vassal of the Byzantine Empire by swearing fealty, and adopt Administrative government.
Work your way to the top of the Byzantine line of succession with promotion and slander, since your stats are strong.
When the emperor dies, take any missing land and take the decision.

achievements.description: Upgrade your Estate with a lvl 5 Villa and fill all external slots
achievements.summary: Upgrade your Estate to a level 5 Villa and fill all its external slots.

guide.context: Becoming Administrative after swearing fealty to the Byzantines also gives you a similar upgraded estate.

steps.text: Set the game rule Extra Administrative Realms - Players to Always.
Start in 1178 as the Holy Roman Empire, which begins with a half-built, upgraded estate.
Finish the Villa upgrade to level 5 and build in every external building slot.

achievements.displayName: It's OK, I Got a Permit
achievements.description: As a non-Powerful family, buy a Remit and successfully Raid the Estate of a Powerful Family
achievements.summary: Without belonging to a Powerful family, buy a Remit and finish a Raid Estate scheme on a Powerful Family's estate.

guide.context: The Remit can vanish without warning and expires if the emperor dies, so start the scheme early.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as a vassal of Basileus Konstantinos X, with good Diplomacy or high liege opinion. Strategos Iosephos of Kilikia Provence is a good pick.
Target the estate of a Powerful Family, best one with no guardhouse upgrade.
Start the Raid Estate scheme first. Get a decent spymaster set to support schemes.
When the scheme is ready to fire, ask the emperor for a Remit with a gold offer and fire the scheme the moment you have it.

achievements.description: As Co-Emperor, rule a Despotate
achievements.summary: As Co-Emperor, rule a Despotate.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Strategos Michael of Philippopolis, who begins as Co-Emperor of Byzantium.
Swing the Scales of Power up to level 3.
Demand a private despotate.

achievements.description: Have five simultaneous House members as Theme governors (not including you) while not being the Emperor
achievements.summary: Have five House members as Theme governors under the same Emperor at once, without being the Emperor yourself.

guide.context: You can also reach this in a normal game inside another Administrative empire, such as an Arabian one. The custom King of France route may not work as described.

steps.text: Set the game rule Extra Administrative Realms - Players to Always.
In 1066 create a King of France aged 50 with five sons.
Give a Theme governorship to each of the five sons. If this does not count, use the Administrative empire route instead.

achievements.description: In 1178, start as the Palaiologos and become Emperors of Byzantium
achievements.summary: Starting in 1178 as the Palaiologos, become Emperor of Byzantium.

guide.context: This must happen within Alexios's lifetime. It is blocked if the Palaiologos successor is female.

steps.text: Play Strategos Alexios or Tourmarches Alexios in 1178.
Choose the Skullduggery focus in the Intrigue Lifestyle, then start murder schemes against the leading candidate for the Empire. Only murder candidates hundreds of score above you.
Promote yourself with political schemes while slandering your rivals. Skip Challenge Status, which is slow and uses your political scheme slot.
Gain influence from governance issues and gifts of gold to heads of powerful families. Use it to hurt rival successors and promote yourself.
Watch the succession window and keep starting political schemes until you lead the line, then wait for the emperor to die.

achievements.displayName: Started from the Bottom now we're ERE
achievements.description: As an Adventurer, buy an Estate in Byzantium and lead your line to become Emperors
achievements.summary: Purchase an Estate in the Byzantine Empire as an Adventurer, then lead your line to become Emperors.

guide.context: Buying the estate costs Todor his special troops. With Khans of the Steppe, a 1178 start is risky since the Mongols can quickly un-land you.

steps.text: Start in 1178 as the landless Master Todor, or in 1066 as Robert Phrangopoulos.
Grow your family first: marry a camp follower, romance courtiers, or do Rescue Fair Subject contracts. You need adult heirs.
Complete contracts for patrons of duchy level inside the Empire, then use Procure Estate on one of them. You need 1000 gold, plus either a weak hook or a high amount of prestige or piety.
Improve your Level of Fame or sway the lord if they refuse.
Save up Influence and push your House as a candidate. With 200+ Influence you may be able to request a governorship, or Influence Candidacy for yourself or adult heirs in other Themes.
Take more land with Start Boundary Disputes against neighbors, preferably Powerful Families.
Once you hold a Theme, use the Meritocracy perk to claim the Empire. Or ask to be made Co-Emperor by the Emperor, then run the Depose scheme for a bloodless coup.

achievements.displayName: The Stallion that Mounts the World
achievements.description: Starting as Temüjin, conquer the world
achievements.summary: Starting as Temujin, control the entire world.

steps.text: First complete the This Chinggis Everything route.
Swap out your Regiments for Keshig and Cataphract Archers drawn from your subjects. Khitan or Tangut vassals give you access to them.

Aim the Offer Submission or Ruin interaction at neighbouring rulers, whatever the 0% Acceptance Chance says. If their culture knows the Trebuchet Innovation, demand siege weapons from them. If it does not, demand special soldiers. This works on armies that are already raised.
Grant conquered Counties and Duchies to local-culture people or to Mongols with high Martial.

With your new vassals, use Demand Submission, plus Demand Conversion or Inspire Conversion. Do not Demand Vassalization any more. Offer Submission or Ruin is more effective and also works on Tributaries.
Keep going until you control the entire world.

achievements.description: Use Overrun Realm CB and settle your people outside the Steppe
achievements.summary: Win a war fought under the Overrun Kingdom Casus Belli, moving your people to land beyond the Great Steppe.

steps.text: Start in 867 as the Khazars.
Declare a war with the Overrun Kingdom Casus Belli and win it.

achievements.description: Have 30 Tributaries
achievements.summary: Have 30 Tributaries at the same time.

steps.text: Play as any large nomad realm.
Release all your vassals as tributaries.

achievements.description: Become the Greatest of Khans
achievements.summary: Gain the Greatest of Khans trait.

guide.context: Army Movement Speed matters in the final wars because enemy armies attack from several sides and retreat when yours nears.

steps.text: Choose a Mongolian nomad ruler strong in Martial, Diplomacy and Prowess. Temujin suits this well.
Do a Nerge Hunt each year with the Substantial party size option and always pick the options that raise the success score. These hunts are where most of your Gold, Prestige and Legitimacy comes from.
Expand through wars using the Casus Belli called Bring under Tribute, Nomadic Quarrels or Expand Dominance. Demand Vassalization and Tributaries between hunts.
Do not accept vassals far from Mongolia, so your realm stays compact.
When your Dominance is high enough, take the Dominate Title decision and then the Become the Greatest of Khans decision.
Win the Great War of Defiance that follows. Defeat the opposing hordes in battle, and capture two or three of their holdings with a second army.
Never choose Move into Conquered Lands, and also skip the decisions Settle the Steppe, Forsake Nomadism and Convert to Local Culture.

achievements.description: Migrate from the eastern Steppe to the western Steppe
achievements.summary: Play a nomad ruler who starts in the Eastern Steppe and migrate west into the Western Steppe.

steps.text: Optional, for a fast migration without wars: shrink your horde to a county-level horde before migrating. You can shrink from a duchy or higher title.
Migrate to a herder county in the Western Steppe. There should always be one. This avoids wars, especially with confederations that can field 10k to 100k coalitions.
Watch out for the Khazars, who can hold most of the western steppe. At least one county should still be independent or herder.
Keep your income positive. A large number of Men-at-Arms can cost too much after you shrink, but you still need an army to face enemies.

achievements.description: Build a Pleasure Dome
achievements.summary: Build a Pleasure Dome.

steps.text: Begin as an emperor anywhere in the Great Steppe.
Build a Pleasure Dome.

achievements.description: Settle in the Steppe
achievements.summary: Become a settled ruler with your capital in the Great Steppe region.

steps.text: Play a strong nomad ruler with a capital inside the Great Steppe region.
Become settled.

achievements.description: Become Blood Brothers
achievements.summary: Become Blood Brothers with another character.

steps.text: Start in 1178 as Temujin. He almost always has a willing Blood Brother at game start.
Make Jamukha, his real Blood Brother who starts as his vassal, your Blood Brother.

achievements.description: Form a Confederation
achievements.summary: Form a Confederation.

steps.text: Make a custom tribal or nomad duke who has the Diplomat trait. Check that a neighbouring count or duke has his culture.
Put the remaining points into Diplomacy.
Take the Call for Confederation decision.
Ask the neighbour to join your confederation.

achievements.description: Host an Excellent Nerge
achievements.summary: Host a Nerge Hunt that ends with an Excellent outcome.

steps.text: Start in 1178 as Temujin, who has ideal skills for this.
Hold a Nerge Hunt. Pick the options that raise the success score the most.
Repeat until the outcome is Excellent. It usually takes a few attempts at most.

achievements.description: Starting as Jarl Hæsteinn in 867, become Hegemon of China
achievements.summary: Become Hegemon of China while playing Jarl Hæsteinn.

guide.context: The wording says starting as Hæsteinn, but you only need to be playing as him.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Jarl Hæsteinn and head east before he dies.
Use the Adventure Casus Belli more than once to stay out of range of the King of France, who will try to kill you.
Hop county to county with the regular Conquer County Casus Belli, for example Dalmatia, Sinai, Oman, Gujarat, Bengal, Vietnam.
Avoid using his special units because they do not refill.
When you border China you get the Claim the Mandate Casus Belli. Use it, beat an enemy, take land and enforce demands.

achievements.description: Claim the Mandate of Heaven as the Head of Faith of a Christian faith
achievements.summary: Claim the Mandate of Heaven while you are the Head of Faith of some Christian faith.

steps.text: Set the game rule Conquerors: Frequency to None, or Vicayala Chola may block the best holy site.
Play Jarl Hæsteinn and head toward India.

Use the Adventure Casus Belli on a Tribal Duchy along Africa's eastern coast, then stop and Raid with the Capture intent. Capture and execute prisoners, and make pilgrimages until you have 4000 Piety.
Conquer Kerala, the Nestorian holy site inside the Raj of Chera Nadu, and keep going toward China without more Adventure Casus Belli.
When the Claim the Mandate Casus Belli unlocks, convert to Nestorianism and found a Christian Faith of your own, making yourself its temporal Head of Faith. New rites cannot be created while at war.
Respec perks to take Apostate and Prophet, which cuts the cost; Hæsteinn begins with 7 Learning perks.
Claim the Mandate and take the Hegemony of China.

achievements.description: Starting as the Chrysanthemum Throne, restore direct imperial rule
achievements.summary: Starting as the Chrysanthemum Throne, own the Empire of Japan and take the Restore Direct Imperial Rule decision.

guide.context: Do not start in 1178, when the realm is already Feudal.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Chikahito.
Take the throne by being elected through politics, or by using the Depose scheme (Intrigue focus helps) on the ruling Kampaku.
Do not abdicate.
If the decision is not yet open, hold activities for prestige, enact the needed laws, and take the decision.
Alternative route: start in 867 as Korehito. Get elected regent and abdicate the ceremonial throne to your heir while keeping control.
Wait for the Royal Prerogative innovation in the Early Medieval era.
Have the heir hold both thrones, then take the decision at the third level of crown authority.

achievements.description: As a Mandala ruler, have a Godlike level of piety, rule an empire, and have 100 radiance
achievements.summary: Hold an empire as a Mandala ruler with the Godlike level of devotion and 100 Radiance.

guide.context: Four rulers are needed. Three must each die at Religious Icon, Divine and Demigod to unlock Godlike, then a fourth must hold Godlike. Each ruler must die from a cause their Aspect accepts.

steps.text: Rule as a Mandala-government ruler and build devotion with Mandala Rituals, Tributaries and Pilgrimages.
Let each ruler die of Natural Causes after reaching the top devotion level they can: Religious Icon, then Divine for the next heir, then Demigod, then Godlike.
At every succession, pick the heir with the designated successor button so the higher devotion cap is applied.
Own an empire and reach 100 Radiance while at Godlike devotion.

achievements.description: Starting as landless, work your way up to becoming a Minister in China
achievements.summary: Start landless and become a Minister on the council of the Hegemony of China.

steps.text: Play a landless character in China and climb to Merit Rank 1 as in Upper-upper.
Raise your candidacy score with influence, interactions and schemes.
Wait until a Ministry becomes available and take it.

achievements.description: Claim the Hegemony of China and choose a name for your new Imperial Dynasty
achievements.summary: Take the Hegemony of China title and name the new Imperial Dynasty.

steps.text: Take the Hegemony of China title.
When asked, pick a name for your Imperial Dynasty.

achievements.displayName: Cut off the Head... and the Body will Follow
achievements.description: Successfully use the Eradicate Casus Belli against a House that you have a Feuding Relation with
achievements.summary: Win a war that you start using the Eradicate Casus Belli, aimed at a House you are Feuding with.

steps.text: Create a martial or intrigue character and keep murdering members of one House that is not in a Bloc, until the Feuding House relation appears.
When you are stronger, declare war on that House using the Eradicate Casus Belli.
Take their capital to win the war.

achievements.description: Become Shōgun, holding the Empire of Japan, as Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1178
achievements.summary: As Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1178, take the Formalize Shogunate decision while holding the Empire of Japan.

steps.text: Start as Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1178. Leave your Bloc, then invite independent vassals to join a new Bloc that you found.
Run Hunts and other prestige activities. When the Assert Regional Dominion decision shows up, take it.
Use Demand Aspiration Change so every House Head in your Bloc follows your Aspiration, until Cohesion reaches 75.
When your Bloc outpowers the Daijo-daijin, begin an Install Ruling Regent faction. Press its demands, and fight the war if one starts.
Raise Legitimacy and Prestige to level 4 and crown authority to Powerful Ministries (level 3).
Take the Formalize Shogunate decision before Yoritomo dies.

achievements.description: Max out your mandala Aspect and have a Grand Temple Complex
achievements.summary: Raise the Mandala Aspect to its highest level and own a Grand Temple Complex.

steps.text: Pick a Mandala ruler; Angkor in 1178 already has a level 3 Capital Temple Complex.
Meet each level's requirement for your Aspect, such as strong knights and high prowess for Destruction, to raise the Aspect and the Capital Temple Complex together.
Continue through further rulers if needed until the Aspect is maxed and the complex is a Grand Temple Complex.

achievements.description: Finish the Confucian Education track and have 5 disciples
achievements.summary: Complete the Confucian Education trait track and gather 5 Disciples.

steps.text: Play in China and progress through the ranks until your Confucian Education trait reaches 100 experience.
Right-click your own character and use Request Mentee on relatives and spouses, who always accept, until you have 5 Disciples.

achievements.description: Have max cohesion in your Bloc
achievements.summary: Reach 100 Cohesion in your Bloc.

steps.text: Start in Japan as a strong Soryo governor, such as a Northern Japan duchy ruler in 1066 or 1178.
Wait until your Bloc Cohesion reaches 75.
Declare and win Bloc Expansion wars, each giving +5 Cohesion, only against realms outside any Bloc, until Cohesion is 100.

achievements.description: Reach the highest level of Merit
achievements.summary: Reach the highest Merit rank, Rank 1.

steps.text: Play a Celestial-government vassal with high Learning.
Join every Examination, prefer Capital Examinations, always choose the Merit options, and use the Study scheme.
After getting a governorship, recruit your most expensive Men-at-Arms if Military, otherwise build up buildings and tax income.
Host Examinations and Inspections for extra Merit until you reach Rank 1.

achievements.description: Take the Unite the Husamguk decision
achievements.summary: Take the Unite the Husamguk decision.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Silla, whose culture is in the Buyeo group.
Conquer the single independent county you still need.
Keep conquering until your realm is large enough, then take the Unite the Husamguk decision.

achievements.description: Found the Dai Viet Empire
achievements.summary: Found the Dai Viet Empire.

steps.text: Start as Viet in 1178, with a historical ruler or a war-focused custom ruler.
Hold a Coronation and swear an Expand the Realm Oath before the first war.
Conquer Champa with county expansion Casus Bellis so you own the Kingdoms of Viet and Champa.
Gather 2000 Prestige and take the decision to found the Dai Viet Empire.

achievements.description: As a Wanua ruler, adopt Mandala government through your Suzerain, and build a Capital Complex
achievements.summary: Starting as a Wanua ruler, switch to Mandala government via your Suzerain and then build a Capital Complex.

steps.text: Start in 867 as Raja Indra Warmandewa of Kutai. Become a tributary by submitting to Raja Aditya of Tanjungpura.
Take the decision to adopt Mandala government.
Get Legitimacy 1, Level of Devotion 2 and at least one Tributary, using Mandala Rituals, Pilgrimage and wars or Embrace as Tributary.
Pay for the Complex Great Project in the Projects tab. It completes after 5 years.

achievements.description: Pass all Exams with one character
achievements.summary: Pass every Exam with one character.

steps.text: Follow the Stamp of Approval route, passing the Children's Examination.
Enter and pass a Provincial Examination when one starts.
Raise Learning and Confucian Education with the Study scheme, a Mentor from Request Mentorship, and Learning Lifestyle perks.
Enter the Emperor's Capital Examination, and place in the top 10 of the Metropolitan Examination to qualify for the Palace Examination.

achievements.description: Starting as a ruler of a culture with no Silk Road Innovations, discover a Silk Road Innovation
achievements.summary: Start with a culture that has no Silk Road Innovations and discover one.

steps.text: Swap out a Silk Road ruler for a custom character. Give them a distant culture plus high Stewardship and Learning.
Pick the decision named Visit a Silk Road Market, then succeed at its skill challenge.

achievements.displayName: Yes I need, I need my Samurai
achievements.description: Adopt Sōryō government as a Ritsuryō ruler
achievements.summary: Change from Ritsuryō to Sōryō government.

steps.text: Start as a Ritsuryō Governor who is a House Head and holds the Domicile.
Collect the resources to upgrade the Domicile Mansion to Level 2 and move it to a County in your Governorship.
Take the decision to adopt Sōryō government.

achievements.description: Starting as a character that has not passed any Exam, pass an Exam in China
achievements.summary: Pass an Exam in China with a character who had passed none before.

steps.text: Make a custom character who is landless and 16 years old. Give them high Learning and the Erudite Oracle trait.
Start a Children's Examination right away and pass it.

achievements.description: Permit a group of religious exiles to settle in your realm
achievements.summary: Let exiles of another religion settle inside your realm.

steps.text: Play in Asia and use the Invite Religious Exiles decision, or wait for the exiles event.
Choose to let the exiles settle in your realm.

achievements.description: Have both the Holy Roman Emperor and the Pope as your Puppets at the same time
achievements.summary: Have the Pope and the Holy Roman Emperor both under your control as Puppets simultaneously.

steps.text: Play an Intrigue-focused emperor with the Schemer trait.
Create a Strong Hook on the Holy Roman Emperor.
Abduct the Pope.
The easiest way to make the Emperor a Puppet is to have the Schemer or Diplomat trait.

achievements.description: Starting as Archbishop Guido of Milan, become Antipope and make the Ambrosian Rite the mainline rite
achievements.summary: As Archbishop Guido of Milan, rise to Antipope and afterwards establish the Ambrosian Rite as the mainline rite.

steps.text: Start in 1066 as Archbishop Guido of Milano.
Build up Learning, gain a claim, and request that claimed land from the Holy Roman Emperor. You must hold land before you can proclaim yourself Antipope.
Form alliances with powerful rulers.
Declare yourself Antipope, then go to war against the Pope.
Win that war and you become the true Pope.
Then try to turn the Ambrosian Rite into the mainline rite. This last part may not work as described.

achievements.description: Starting as a Duke-or-lower secular ruler, or a Count-tier cleric, become the Pope
achievements.summary: Become the Pope after beginning as a secular ruler of Duke rank or lower, or as a Count-tier cleric.

steps.text: Start as a secular ruler of Duke rank or lower, or as a cleric of Count rank.
Become the Pope.
@warn{The Possible achievements list can show this achievement even when the start condition was not recorded in your save. Without it, becoming Pope does not unlock it.}

achievements.description: Make your Puppet Pope sleep with your spouse
achievements.summary: Make your Puppet Pope successfully seduce your spouse.

steps.text: Unlock the Befriend perk from the Diplomacy tree.
Raise your opinion with the Pope until you can make him your Puppet.
Have your spouse use Seduce or Romance on him.
Switching your Countermeasure Focus to Strengthen Sentries helps the seduction succeed.

achievements.displayName: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Grandson
achievements.description: As a Theocrat, establish a Dynasty and hold an Archbishopric for three generations
achievements.summary: As a lowborn Theocrat, take the Establish a Dynasty decision and hold an Archbishopric through three generations.

steps.text: Play a lowborn ruler with Ecclesiastical government in 1178, when every Ecclesiastical Catholic culture has Chronicle Writing.
Reach the Illustrious (3) level of Fame and the Faithful (2) level of Devotion.
Adopt the High Church Authority Law, then take the Establish a Dynasty decision.
Hold an Archbishopric title across three generations of your dynasty.
Roman Rite forbids Clerical Marriage, so change to one of these rites instead: Apostolic, Slavic Rite, Ambrosian Rite or Insularism. You keep the Archbishopric.

achievements.description: Demand Church Succession from another ruler, then murder them and inherit their lands
achievements.summary: Murder another ruler after demanding Church Succession from them, then inherit their titles.

steps.text: Find an elderly secular ruler with no children or grandchildren as heirs.
Use Demand Church Succession on that ruler.
Murder them and inherit their titles.

achievements.description: As an Archbishop, change a tenet or doctrine at an Ecumenical Council hosted in your own Cathedral
achievements.summary: As an Archbishop, get a tenet or doctrine change approved during an Ecumenical Council that takes place in your own Cathedral.

steps.text: Run the Ecumenical Council activity at your own Cathedral while you are an Archbishop.
Get one tenet or doctrine change, or more, voted through.

achievements.description: Starting as a non-Clergy ruler, have five members of your dynasty as Cardinals at the same time
achievements.summary: Begin as a ruler outside the Clergy and get five members of your dynasty serving as Cardinals together.

steps.text: Take the Befriend perk and befriend the Pope.
Make the Pope your Puppet.
Name five Clergy dynasty members as Cardinals.

achievements.description: Enshrine a relic taken from a saint of your own family in a Holy Site your Dynasty founded
achievements.summary: Place a relic from a Saint in your own family into a Holy Site that your Dynasty established.

steps.text: Make a custom character who has 3 virtue traits and at least one child.
After they die, play their heir and make the first character a Saint.
Extract a relic from the saint's remains.
Only after that, found a new Holy Site and put the relic in during setup. If the site comes first, the achievement may not unlock.

achievements.description: Have three Personal Tenets and 100 Spiritual Fulfillment at the same time
achievements.summary: Hold three Personal Tenets together with 100 Spiritual Fulfillment.

steps.text: Make a custom ruler who is Zealous and a Wise Man (or Wise Woman).
Give them a Gnosticism rite: Bogomilism, Catharism, Paulicianism or Druze.
Add more traits that count as virtues.
